## 1. Agency Overview & Details

Hey Digital is a premier, B2B-focused digital engineering and performance marketing agency. We specialize in developing fast, secure, search-engine-ready custom static sites, custom native and cross-platform mobile apps (Flutter, iOS, Android), Shopify store designs, and bespoke script automation.

## 2. Main Service Lines

### 2.1 Web Development Services
We specialize in custom web development bypassing standard, slow templates.
- **Architectures:** Single Page Applications (SPA), Multi-Page Applications (MPA), Static Site Generators (SSG), Headless CMS systems.
- **Languages / Frameworks:** Next.js, React, Node.js, Express, HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla ES6 JavaScript.
- **Differentiators:** Standard Next.js server-side static generation loading under 1 second, zero SQL database vectors exposed to malicious scripts, integrated schema markup.

### 2.2 Mobile App Development (Flutter, Android, iOS)
We build native and cross-platform mobile applications engineered to scale.
- **Cross-Platform:** Flutter & Dart scripting. Cuts development budgets by 40% while preserving native rendering layers.
- **Android Native:** Kotlin & Java using Android Studio. Full optimization for diverse Android hardware fragments.
- **iOS Native:** Swift & SwiftUI conforming strictly to Apple's Human Interface Guidelines (HIG).

### 2.3 Shopify E-Commerce Customizations
We code bespoke Shopify architectures from scratch.
- **Services:** Custom Liquid template programming, headless storefront integrations (Shopify Hydrogen & Oxygen), checkout API configurations, third-party payment integration (Razorpay, Cashfree, UPI), site speed audits.

### 2.4 SEO & Digital Performance Marketing
We build high-ROI acquisition pipelines for B2B brands.
- **SEO Services:** Technical SEO audit, structural JSON-LD schema integrations, sitemap synchronization, keyword mapping, local map ranking optimization, white-hat link acquisition.
- **Ads Campaigns:** Google Search Ads (PPC), Meta/Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Conversion API setups, tracking pixel setups.

### 2.5 Business Automation & Custom Scripting
We streamline manual operations via automated scripts and tools.
- **Capabilities:** Zapier/Make setup, webhook scripting, custom Python data parser setups, Cron script scheduling, API integrations, Zoho/HubSpot CRM syncing, WhatsApp business notification relays.

## 3. Case Studies

### 3.1 Custom Shopify E-Commerce Store Build
- **Target:** A regional brand wanted to scale sales to 1,000+ orders/day without platform crashes.
- **Implementation:** Created custom Liquid modules, compressed theme assets, optimized tracking pixels, and removed redundant apps.
- **Result:** Decreased average page load speed to 1.8s, resulting in a 32% increase in checkout conversions.

### 3.2 Technical SEO & Organic B2B Leads
- **Target:** Rank locally for competitive web design and SEO terms in Tamil Nadu.
- **Implementation:** Built targeted service pages, injected local business schemas, and standardized metadata structures.
- **Result:** Ranked #1 on Google maps for local terms and generated a 200% increase in organic B2B leads.

### 3.3 Enterprise Web Development
- **Target:** Develop a custom portal with fast transitions and zero server vulnerability vectors.
- **Implementation:** Built a static website utilizing React components, using Swup.js for fast animations and Page Transitions.
- **Result:** Improved Core Web Vitals to a 100/100 score, resulting in lower bounce rates.
